authorization: User explicitly requested keeping the additional independent2%Conrad modulus errors as a diagnostic and investigating datasets driving the remaining theta discrepancy.
scope: Dataset influence at a retained diagnostic error baseline; no source error replacement, author workflow claim, catalog change or replacement EOS.

diagnostic_baseline.meaning: All three selected Conrad KS points retained with sigmaY=sqrt(formal_upper_width^2+(0.02*KS)^2), independent across pressures. This is an explicitly hypothetical error allowance, never measured source uncertainty.

fixed_background: Same equations, IRLS objective, calibration, reference state and other estimated errors. No new normalization, errors or specimen corrections. Remove unused Kono/Gwanmesia scale coefficients when their series is deleted. Conrad is never deleted or renormalized.
case_design: For each of two normalizations: baseline, published-theta fixed with five other coefficients fitted, eleven disjoint non-Conrad-series deletions and two overlapping whole-publication deletions (Milani and Isaak). Thirty cases, two starts each.
profile_protocol: At the fixed-theta fit, freeze all219 effective pressure errors and evaluate published-all, fixed-theta and free-baseline coefficient vectors. Project theta derivative away from five scaled nuisance columns (K0,Kprime,gamma,Kono scale,Gwanmesia scale). Sum squared residualized derivatives for conditional information fractions and minus derivative times residual /total information for signed local upward-theta contributions in K. These are a local frozen-error linearization, not causal shares or significance tests.
temperature_summary: Aggregate the existing row scores without new fitting into T<298K,298<=T<700K,T>=700K for each series. Retain exact row identifiers and all contributions, including negative ones. No temperature subset search.
native_curves: Independent forward native V/KS at measured P/T for the published-all, full diagnostic baseline and fixed-theta fits, with each vector using its own explicit modulus multipliers. Unweighted native residuals do not equal the pressure-coordinate objective.
compute_cap: Exactly30scientific cases, two unchanged starts each=60optimizations; max30IRLS steps and400evaluations per inner solve, unchanged tolerances. Verification may replay declared cases. Document bounds, failed convergence or lost rank without widening the study. No post-result deletion combinations, weight changes or extra EOS parameters.
reporting: All cases and both starts, free/fixed coefficients, covariance/rank, objective, retained identities/errors, theta and Kprime shifts. Compare influence directions across both normalizations; track gamma/theta correlation and Kprime movement so a theta match is not mistaken for full source parity.
preservation: Canonical observations/errors, all prior scientific artifacts and published coefficients unchanged. No author contact, push or release.
